title: review follow-ups of PR #37698: dashboard Default Period zh names not pinned to the period chip words
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7203741536 on PR #37698, nit N1, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37698 (Fixes #37607) shows Chinese option names on the page inspector's type and record-action pickers and on the report and dashboard "Default Period" pickers, by copying the platform zh-CN pack's option names into the console's override table. Its review left one item open:

- [ ] **The dashboard picker is not pinned to the period chip's words** (N1). `ReportDefaultInspector.defaultPeriodLabels-36835.test.tsx` pins only the report picker's Chinese names to the console rows the period filter chip reads (`dashboard.filters.range.*`). The dashboard picker is pinned only to the platform pack's own dashboard row. The two pack maps are identical today, so a platform edit to the dashboard row alone would make the dashboard picker and the chip disagree with no test failing. Expected: the same loop over `getDashboardForm('zh-CN')` in that test.

Category ①: a missing pin on a shipped label pairing.
Priority: p3 (no wrong text ships today).
Business reason: a Chinese-language admin setting a dashboard's default period would read one word in the picker and another on the filter chip after an unrelated platform translation edit.
Reader: the ux-lane dev who next edits the dashboard inspector or the zh-CN metadata-form pack.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37698"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37607, #36835, PR #37698.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against `main`) · evidence: read → p3
